en:
All right.
I'll help, for a bit.
Y-You mean it, sir!?

Yeah, but I'm not doing this for you.
This is for the cats.

I won't stand for them getting killed.
No animal deserves a fate that cruel.
Thank you so much, sir!

Kiryu-san! You're a real blessing to feline-kind!
Now let's clean up the streets!
So? What do you need me to do?

Right. If you come across a stray somewhere,
give it food until it takes a shine to you.

It might take a few attempts before
it really latches on, so just keep trying!
So I find cats, and feed them.

Yes. Each one will like different food, though.
Take that into consideration.

I'll go anywhere in the country for my feline friends!
Give it your all, Kiryu-san!

If things go well, I may even scrounge
together a thank-you gift someday.
Sounds good.

Well then, Kiryu-san...
The time is meow!
(What have I gotten myself into...?)
It's a crime to be that cute...
That should be good.
Okay, time to get in touch with that café manager.

Kiryu-san! Thank you so much!
I'll make sure this little guy loves his new home!

Let me know if you find any more kitty cats!
Thanks in advance!

It's Kiryu.
I found a cat for you.

That's great news, Kiryu-san!
Where are you right now?

Onomichi...
I don't think I recognize that street name.
Well, it's down in Hiroshima.

Oh, yes yes. That one.
...Wait, <font_kind=yakuza_italic>Hiroshima</font_kind>!?

What? I thought you said you'd go anywhere
to help one of your feline friends.

Th-That's true... but I didn't really think
you'd go so far away...

Regardless, I'll keep my promise!
Just wait there, I'll send someone!

I'll make sure they're there soon.
Thanks again for this, Kiryu-san!

Nyan Nyan Café, at your service!
I heard you have a furry friend for us!

Please let us know if you find any more!
Well, I'm off!

Well? That's a lot of cats.
You guys should be set now, right?

Yes! We're chock full of furry friends.
Thank you so much for all your help!

I know this isn't much...
but I want you to have it.

I guess this is the end of my journey.
Honestly, I'm a little sad.

But all those adorable furballs you found
will be waiting for you at my café, Kiryu-san.
Feel free to stop by whenever you want!
Yeah, I will.
Meow then... Thank you again!
Hey, what's going on, you guys?

Whoa! They haven't been this amped for a while!
They must've really missed you, Kiryu-san.
Hm? Why do you say that?

Like I said, they've been pretty low-energy.
I'm pretty sure it's 'cause they were lonely.
Is that true, you guys?

That reminds me, Kiryu-san! How would you
feel about coming in to feed them every so often?

That way they won't miss you so much!
I don't want 'em running out on me again...
I'm not so sure.

Guess I can't say no.
I've come this far. Can't back out now.

Y-You really mean it!?
You're the cat's meow, Kiryu-san!

Well, just come see me when you're available!
Let's make these little guys purr!
(I don't have any cat food...)
Stop stalling and start explaining!
P-Please, you got it all wrong!
Is this... a lover's quarrel?

I know what you've been up to!
I've seen how much money you spend!
Huh? That's, um...

How often do you see her?
Do you really love her!?

W-Well, talking to her
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>does</font_kind> excite me...

Huh? So you won't deny it?
Ugh, you're the lowest of the low!

Wait, I've never even met her, though!
That means I wasn't cheating!

How can you say that!?
Not like it matters. We're finished!
Ah! Wait, Yuka-chan!

Sorry, man!
Crap, where's Yuka-chan?

She's gone...
Damn it all...
Hey, pull yourself together.

But she's taking this all wrong.
I just got a <font_kind=yakuza_italic>little</font_kind> hooked on live chat...
Live... chat?

Yeah, you heard me.
I've been spending all my time there.

Yuka-chan somehow thought
I was cheating on her, though...

But she's wrong, right!? Live chat isn't
cheating, I just know it! Don't you agree?

Sorry, but I can't weigh in if I don't
know what you're talking about.

Huh? You don't know live chat!?
How is that possible!?

It's exactly what it sounds like!
You know what a chat room is, right?
Ch-Chat room...

Of course I know. That's a room
full of adorable kittens, right?
No, that would be a <font_kind=yakuza_italic>cat</font_kind> room.

A chat room, on the other hand, is
a handy way to talk to people online.

A chat room, huh? It's where you go
to have short conversations with people.
Sort of, but there's more to it than that.

A chat room refers specifically to
a handy way to talk to people online.

A chat room... That's some kind of
online messaging group, right?
Yes, you're totally right!

As for live chat, it's a chat room made
especially for talking to cute girls.
Hmm... So it's an online cabaret club?

I guess you could say that...
but live chat is way better!

After all, some things are off-limits at cabarets.
Y'know, the <font_kind=yakuza_italic>really good</font_kind> stuff.
The... really good stuff?
Have I piqued your interest?
Y-Yeah, maybe a little bit.

Awesome! Man, just thinking about
live chat makes me wanna go again.

That's it! If you come with me to
live chat, I can teach you how to do it!
Huh? Me...?

Yup! My favorite net café's right over there,
so just drop by when you're in the mood!
I'll show you everything, and so will the girls!
I'm no good with computers, though...

Don't worry, I'll help you through it!
Onward to the <font_kind=yakuza_italic>really good</font_kind> stuff!

Well, I'll be waiting for you!
See you over there!
Y-Yeah, I'll stop by at some point.

Live chat, huh? I guess I <font_kind=yakuza_italic>am</font_kind> interested.
I should poke my head into that net café...
We are a members only internet café.

For only 5,000 yen a month, you'll get full access
to our services. Would you like to join?
Yeah, sign me up.

Thank you.
Use this as your membership card.
Please enjoy your stay.

I understand.
We look forward to your return.

Oh, there you are!
I'm all ready, so let's go!

Okay.
I don't know what to do, though.

Don't worry, I'll be by your side the whole time!
Come on, let's get chatting!

I recommend DMM if you want to live chat. 
Double-click this icon.

When it comes to live chat, this is the site.
Start by double-clicking on that icon.

Icon? Um...
So... Like this...?
Perfect! You're connected to the site now.

Just click a girl's photo to start chatting.
Easy, huh?

Oh, and you can send messages by
just typing them out and pressing enter.
Typing's not really my strong suit...
Ah! That one looks pretty cute, doesn't she?
Agreed. Let's go.

All right, you're in!
Live chat starts now. Simple, right?

Hello there!
Is this your first time?
H-Hey, why's she talking to me!?

Don't worry, this is how it works.
Just type your response out to her.

R-Right. But... how am I
supposed to respond to that?

How about a compliment or a greeting?
"You're cute," or maybe "Sup?"!
You... are... very... cute...
W-Well?

You think I'm cute?
I'm so glad!

Look, she's blushing!
You're doing it, you're doing it!

Huh.
So this is live chat...
Yup! Now get those keys clacking!

Uh, what?
Is that <font_kind=yakuza_italic>really</font_kind> what I should put?
I think I messed up...

Hey there!
'Sup to you, too!

Whoa, she liked that!
You're doing it, you're doing it!

Huh.
So this is how live chat goes...
Yup yup! Now get those keys clacking!
This... is... so... much... fun...
It's fun for me, too! <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Dude, you're like some kinda chat wizard!
She's totally loving it!

I wasn't sure how this would turn out,
but it's actually kinda fun.

Ain't it?
But the <font_kind=yakuza_italic>real</font_kind> best of live chat is yet to come!
Huh? There's more?

You bet there is.
Ah, here it comes!

You've been so sweet to me today...
Why don't I make up for it? <symbol=note_with_outline>

Sh-She's stripping!
Hey, what do I do now!?

You're getting a private show!
This is the true live chat now!

Wh-Whoa...!
Live chat is... amazing...

Damn right it is!
Now let's get the show started!
So curvy!
Tell her to show us more!
Show... me... some... more... please...
She really is...
That was great.

So what did you think?
Pretty damn fun, huh?

Yeah, how do I put this...
It was refreshing, to say the least.

I can understand how you got
wrapped up in all this.

But no matter how fun it is,
you shouldn't ignore your girlfriend.

I've actually been considering that...
and I've reached a turning point.

Yup! I've decided I don't need
a girlfriend anymore!

Live chat's way more enticing than a girlfriend
could ever be! Don't you think?

Real-life women can be moody,
but chat ladies are always energetic and cute!

Besides, having a girlfriend would
just cut into my chat time.

So I'm better off not having one at all!
That way, I can chat forever without regret!
Well, I guess that's one angle...

A new me is born today!
I'm gonna devote my life to live chat!

Speaking of, I should log back in there.
We should talk some more later!

Maybe next time we see each
other will be in a chat room!
Uh... Yeah...

Live chat...
What a rush...

Man, RIZAP's the real deal, huh?
Totally proved me wrong.

It's pretty freaking amazing.
I mean, check out this slim body!

And you used to be a real chubfest, too.
Nice, RIZAP! Think I should join up too?

For sure, for sure!
You're not gonna regret it!

RIZAP...
I've heard a lot about this gym lately.
All right, I'll see what this is all about.

Hm? Can I help you, sir?
Are you interested in joining our gym?

Hm? Oh, nah.
I just wanted to see what it's about.

Very well, sir. We usually ask for
appointments, but I've got a moment.
This is where you check in, sir.

RIZAP... I've heard a lot about this gym lately.
Should I head in?
Welcome, sir!
This is, uh... my first time.

So you're a new customer.
Then first, let me explain how we do things.

We're a membership-based gym, outfitted with dozens
of private training rooms and state-of-the-art equipment.

Members only, huh?
I need to join?

Yep! First you'll need to undergo
a free counseling session.

Based on that session, we then create
a personalized training plan, just for you.

If you like what we have on offer,
you'll be able to register right then and there.

Interesting. So I get free counseling,
then decide whether or not I wanna join...
All right then, I'll give it a shot.

Great, let me go get your counselor, sir.
Please take a seat over there.
Sure, no prob.
Thank you for waiting, sir.

I'll be both your counselor and trainer.
The name's Makuta.

Wait, you're the trainer, too?
Anyway, I'm Kazuma Kiryu. Good to meet you.

Kiryu-san, then? Great name.
You're already in great shape, too!

Such finely toned muscles!
I'll have to beef up my training to match you!

Now then, let me tell you just
how things go down here at RIZAP.
Please do.

As our receptionist mentioned,
we're known for our private training rooms.

Each member gets one-on-one care from a trainer,
resulting in absolutely out of this world service!

Oh, and you can change trainers whenever you want!
Find the one that suits your style!
That option sounds kinda appealing...

One more thing we offer here<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
We also include free diet advice to help you slim down!

So you do training...
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>And</font_kind> you plan my meals?

That's right. Our dietitians work 'round the clock
to offer only the best tips for maximum gains!

I mean, a customer who never eats protein would
never get the rippling muscles he desires, right?

Our training and diet tips are absolutely vital for
getting the most out of your experience.

True enough.
I guess you have a point there.

Now then, a training session and a diet plan
combine to form one round of the RIZAP Challenge.

As a member of our gym, you'll have the opportunity
to take on 12 whole RIZAP Challenge rounds.
And that's the whole RIZAP experience!
Great. Sounds pretty useful.
Now then, let's head to the counseling room!

Your answers'll help us map out your training plan,
so be sure to tell the truth!
Yeah, I can do that.

Well, that concludes the assessment.
The counseling part of our training is now over!

I have the perfect regimen for you, Kiryu-san.
Come on, take a look!

Wow, it actually looks pretty good.
I'm impressed.

Don't be.
Training you right is just part of my job.

Anyway, Kiryu-san...
How do you feel about joining us?
